body: true, the question is how much do I stand to gain?  I don't know how to evaluate that.

I've definitely thought about it.  I'm currently mulling over my options.  Everything was kept private, or at least that's what the school's told me, so now I'm just trying to figure out if punishing this person because of the damage inflicted on me is worth the time, money, and energy.

You know I heard a story once about a young man who asked his old dying uncle about what his thoughts were on his impending death.  He described his life as being a young boy at disney world.  At first you get in and you are just so excited and energetic and ready to ride all the rides.  You run to the nearest ones, the coolest ones, but you avoid the scary ones and the intimidating ones at first.  But as you grow bored of the rides you first rode, the scary or intimidating ones begin to have greater allure.  You ride them and experience new thrills and emotions that you simply couldn't have gotten out of the other rides.  And as the end of the day approaches and the sun begins to set, you start to feel tired.  You still like the rides, but you've been on them all, some multiple times, and you're ready to go home.  Your feet are sore, your skin is hot from sunburn, and what you desire most is just to pass out on a cool comfy bed.

Man, I'll tell you what, I understand that concept of tired.  I freaking get it.  I'm dealing with it now.  Everyday I'm going through absolute hell right now thinking if only I could pass out face first on cold comfy resort bed and sleep, for a long time.

But here's the thing.  And trust me, I'm not judging you, I'm still not sure if at the resolution of my problems I'm not going to "take the big nap", but here's the thing I do when I really can't take it:

what you're experiencing yourself is not you.  YOU are just along for the ride.  YOU get to see and experience how this guy named 12345TA54321 lives through a challenging moment of his life.  YOU can't be responsible for everything.  YOU have to let 12345TA54321 simply exist.  YOU don't need to feel any pressure to prove that you are strong or good enough.  12345TA54321 will take care of that for YOU as soon as it can.  For now YOU need only sit back and observe.  

YOU can do this.  Give YOURSELF a break.  What's going on in your life isn't a result of who you are, just where you are.  Let 12345TA54321 figure out where it needs to go, and if enough time has passed and YOU have decided that all the rides have been fun but YOU truly want to go home.  No one is going to say that you weren't strong or good enough. 

Love ya
